occurrences.checkable_against: MAPLE-HCM presentation and JACC: Heart Failure publication
occurrences.quote_span: Results of a post-hoc analysis from MAPLE-HCM, the Phase 3 clinical trial of aficamten compared to metoprolol in patients (n=175) with symptomatic obstructive HCM (oHCM), were presented in a Late Breaking Clinical Trial Session and simultaneously published in the Journal of the American College of Cardiology: Heart Failure .
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: MAPLE-HCM enrolled 175 patients, randomized on a 1:1 basis to receive aficamten or metoprolol as monotherapy in a double-blind, double dummy fashion.
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: Aficamten improved pVO 2 compared with metoprolol for patients not previously taking beta blockers (LSM difference +3.1 mL/kg/min, p<0.001), as well as for patients previously taking beta blockers (LSM difference +1.9 mL/kg/min, p<0.001) with no difference between groups in the improvement (interaction p = 0.133).
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: At screening, 123 patients were taking a beta blocker while 52 patients were not taking a beta blocker.
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: Similarly, compared to metoprolol , aficamten significantly improved key secondary endpoints independent of pre-trial treatment, including KCCQ-CSS and New York Heart Association (NYHA) Functional Class, Valsalva left ventricular outflow tract gradient (LVOT-G) and NT-proBNP.
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: There were no differences in the safety profile of aficamten , including the rates of serious adverse events, between pre-trial treatment groups.
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: Of the 52 patients not taking a beta blocker at screening, 22 patients had received no standard of care therapy for at least 12 months before screening.
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial

occurrences.quote_span: As previously reported, the primary results of MAPLE-HCM demonstrated superiority of aficamten to metoprolol on pVO 2 (change from baseline to Week 24, least squares mean (LSM) treatment difference (SE), +2.3 (0.39) mL/kg/min, p<0.001).
occurrences.speaker: Cytokinetics
occurrences.subject: Cytokinetics MAPLE-HCM aficamten trial
